instruction: An artistic studio portrait photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background, the redhead woman (R1) sits on the left wearing a light blue shirt and beige skirt, holding a bouquet of yellow, red, and white flowers in both hands while looking away to the left with a serene profile expression. Sitting back-to-back and leaning against her, the dark-haired woman (R2) on the right wears a beige blazer, looking directly at the camera with a calm, poised expression. The composition is illuminated by soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a neutral, warm color palette.
